description:
Wrong album association (and fav flag added not wanted) after using deduplication tool

Hi!
I was using the dedup tool which presented 5 (very) different videos files from 5 different albums (another issue about this case is opened here #27688 
I chose to keep all of them.

After that, all those videos were added to the whole 5 albums from each came from, and were marked as favorites (only one of them were favorite marked).

I tested the bug with 2 identical pictures, putted in 2 different albums (each one only in one album).
I opened the dedup tool, chose to keep all of them, and they were added, both of them, to each album.
Thank you for considering my issue ;-)

tests_added: duplicate.service.spec.ts: should not merge metadata when multiple assets are kept

evidence: test: duplicate.service.spec.ts: should not merge metadata when multiple assets are kept

notes: Symptom-only issue (dedup tool keep-all adds assets to other albums / favourites). Fix wraps the metadata merge in DuplicateService.resolveGroup with `idsToKeep.length === 1 && idsToTrash.length > 0`; RC exact; description does not state the change.
